hypothesis: Exact PR comparison and landing evidence can be indexed without a code graph at each changed commit, separating retrieval coverage from code-snapshot coverage.

sampling.note: All evaluated cases are known development evidence. This round establishes evidence reconstruction and query coverage, not held-out ranking generalization.

pre_registered_controls: Use the same frozen latest-subject selection and exact payload digests. Independent source families may support reconstruction; do not restore an older complete observation hidden by a newer incomplete observation in the same family.

Keep proposal merge-base/head differences distinct from first-parent landing differences. A proposal does not imply unmerged state, and a populated merge_commit_sha on an unmerged PR is not landing evidence.
Retain conflicting observed endpoint pairs separately. Equivalent pairs may share native computation, but source provenance remains available.
Measure object readability during reconstruction; do not relabel it as historical availability at the source observation time.

Compare native batched diffs against independent per-pair Git diffs, including empty changes, unrelated histories, multiple merge bases, missing objects, root commits, modes, submodules and byte-exact path boundaries.
Code inputs remain captured raw stack paths and native CBM bindings. No reference PR or known changed file may construct a retrieval query.

Evaluate exact path overlap and changed-file BM25 as fixed controls, with primary budget 20 and secondary budgets 10 and 30. Collapse to distinct PRs before applying budgets and exclude the same 25 source threads.
Report code-graph-independent coverage separately from ranking quality, and never count an unreadable comparison as an empty diff.
acceptance: Source ownership, field pointers, native boundaries and file changes are independently verified.
The index remains a rebuildable derived structure; canonical Git/SQLite data are never modified.
Native batch and individual Git results agree, all query hits retain source and comparison identities, and sealed-index query replay is deterministic.
Real-data build/query costs, unavailable evidence and regression results remain visible before any local research commit.
No default promotion without an independent later ranking validation.

implementation.boundary: Proposal differences use exact observed base/head endpoints and a native unique merge base or empty tree. Landing differences use an observed landing commit against its first parent, or the empty tree for a root. No mutable refs or graph endpoint constrain these comparisons.
implementation.index: SQLite comparison records retain every equivalent source alias; conflicting endpoint pairs remain separate. Native name-status changes use byte-exact paths. Exact overlap and file BM25 collapse comparisons to distinct PRs before applying a budget.
native_fixture_findings: diff-tree --stdin with two commit IDs treats the second as a synthetic parent of the first, reversing the intended before/after direction. Peel both endpoints to tree IDs and verify each exact tree-pair header.
A missing commit in the batch protocol can be skipped with success. Preflight exact objects and reject missing output markers instead of interpreting the result as an empty change.
A successful file diff does not imply all blobs are present. Missing blobs and missing subtrees have separate native fixtures; complete denotes the file-difference query only.
implementation.graph_use: Reuse captured source-verified CBM bindings. No additional graph projection, archive copy, code graph construction or synthetic traversal was performed.

gates.retrieval_verification_note: Counts repeat evidence shared across cases. Each query result has exact source semantics, a separately reconstructed native boundary and full-file-diff equality; the full index audit separately covers every complete pair.
gates.replay_normalization: Remove only seconds recursively. All other fields in each complete original/replay artifact are equal.

results.metric: A case hits if any explicitly linked merged PR is in the distinct-PR budget. This is a closing-reference retrieval measure, not demonstrated symptom resolution.
results.interpretation: Snapshot-independent file evidence improves particular cases but the text-plus-union BM25 control hits 7/21 at budget 20 versus R008's 8/21. No new default or held-out generalization claim is justified.

qualitative_evidence.finding: The BitsAndBytes loader raises the reported unsupported-quantization AttributeError when the model lacks bitsandbytes_stacked_params_mapping. The log names LlavaForConditionalGeneration; its native CBM class file lies outside the raw stack paths. The one-file, nine-line landing patch adds exactly that class attribute. This aligns a static precondition and patch, but no model execution was performed.

The extracted Windows registry subprocess log contains PermissionError for a temporary file and an unsupported-architecture wrapper. The explicitly closing patch instead disables GPTQ quantization for the Qwen2-VL visual module. Shared model identity and an authentic closing link do not establish a fix for this extracted error. Preserve the registered reference metric, but do not count this as a demonstrated causal gain.

The native proposal changes V1 profiling and engine compatibility in two files. This is useful retrievable proposed code, not an observed landed fix; its mechanism for the input's duplicate request-ID error remains unverified.

Both proposal and landing are reconstructable beyond the graph endpoint, but neither has an exact path intersection with any registered query-path control. Extending history alone cannot repair the V0 stack versus V1 pause/sleep patch mismatch.

availability.live_rebuild_claim: The fixed SQLite selection does not freeze the concurrently growing Git object store. A later full rebuild may legitimately gain complete records. Only the stable fixture has byte-identical rebuild evidence; real queries replay against this sealed index.
availability.upstream: No new source schema is required by this experiment. Missing reference heads are unobserved at the cutoff, not declared permanently unavailable; existing pull-git/commit-object acquisition can supply them. Canonical data were not fetched or modified.

cost.query_cost_boundary: Excludes startup, index attestation, source/native verification and CBM input resolution. This is not end-to-end agent latency.

next.hypothesis: Source-preserved diagnostic constraints and exact patch changes can distinguish symptom-aligned candidates from merely related files or closing references.
next.first_action: Inspect source-code preconditions and native patches on known cases before choosing a minimal query or reranking control. Do not infer applicability from a closing link or introduce a new code graph.
next.validation: Keep all 24 cases as development evidence. Freeze any selected policy before inspecting fresh inputs; retain a separate assessment of reference applicability instead of retroactively editing hit counts.
